gloss: essential item; must-have item; indispensable thing to carry

definitions.gloss: essential item; must-have item; indispensable thing to carry

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧。
⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}だ。
examples.english: A folding umbrella is an essential item during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧や{常備薬|じょうびやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ようにしましょう。
examples.english: As essentials for overseas travel, make sure not to forget copies of your passport and your regular medications.

notes:
Composed of {必携|ひっけい} (must-carry, indispensable) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods). Often used in travel guides, packing lists, and product recommendations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}: travel essentials
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}: essential mountaineering gear
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必携品|ひっけいひん}: winter must-haves
- {必携品|ひっけいひん}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: essentials list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: necessities, daily essentials — things needed for living, not necessarily portable
- ⟦{持|も}ち{物|もの}→持ち物：03165_mochimono⟧: belongings, things to bring — neutral term without the "essential" nuance
- {携行品|けいこうひん}: items carried on one's person — formal, often used in official or insurance contexts
